title: Restriction to a localized site preserves quasi-isomorphisms with independent coefficient universe
statement: Let C be any category with Grothendieck topology J, R a sheaf of rings, and U an object of C [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let t:L′→L be a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] of unbounded cochain complexes of sheaves of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The termwise restriction functor to sheaves of R|U-modules sends t to a quasi-isomorphism. The explicit zero-morphism-preservation witness only supplies the map-on-complexes construction; it adds no mathematical restriction. This universe-general form takes C : Type u with Category v and coefficient/module universe max u v r, for arbitrary r; assume abelian-group sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on the original site. It uses the same sheaves, restriction, Hom complex, differentials, and induced maps as the original source statement.

source.place: Section 03DH, restriction j_U^*; exactness recalled in Lemma 18.19.4 (03DK)

proof.text: Work with objects in Type u, arrows in Type v, and coefficient rings and modules in Type (max u v r). Use the existing siteAbelianHasSheafify and siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective instances on the slice whenever an abelian or exactness instance is needed. All these instances are proved, and the given base-site instances are retained.

Let F be module restriction, G the forgetful functor on the slice to abelian sheaves, and H abelian-sheaf restriction. The equality F composed with G = toSheaf R composed with H is definitional, expressed in Lean by Iso.refl. The source-library instance Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_sheafPushforwardContinuous gives finite-limit preservation of H. Module forgetting preserves finite limits and reflects finite limits (Mathlib); transport the composite preservation across the identity comparison and reflect through G to obtain finite-limit preservation of F.

Over.forget U is cocontinuous for every Grothendieck topology. Mathlib Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous makes H a left adjoint, hence it preserves colimits of size max u v, and therefore finite colimits. The proved source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesFiniteColimits_toSheaf supplies finite-colimit preservation of module forgetting. G reflects isomorphisms, so it reflects each finite colimit because these colimits exist and G preserves them (reflectsColimitsOfShape_of_reflectsIsomorphisms). Transfer composite preservation across the same identity comparison and reflect through G to obtain finite-colimit preservation of F. No binary products of the site, commutativity of its rings, or chosen precoverage are required.

Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products gives additivity of F from finite-limit preservation. Finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation supply Functor.PreservesHomology via Mathlib preservesHomologyOfExact. HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology applied to t and F is exactly the stated conclusion. All imported preservation instances are proved, and no new intermediate theorem with sorry is needed.
